description: This is a shell script file that contains test cases for the 'git rebase --onto' command. It sets up various git repository states and verifies the behavior of different rebase scenarios, including edge cases and error conditions.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution of commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting the command to fail.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the actual output with expected output.

methods.name: test_cmp_rev
methods.description: Compares revisions to verify cherry-pick or rebase operations.

methods.name: test_editor_unchanged
methods.description: Verifies that the editor state remains unchanged after tests.

methods.name: set_fake_editor
methods.description: Sets up a fake editor for testing rebase interactions.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with a specified message.
